site.name: MapRaccoon
site.description: Pick a few places, send one link, let everyone vote. A going-out planner for friends in Phnom Penh.

hero.lead: Bars, restaurants and cafés across Phnom Penh, sorted by what’s open right now. Pick a few, send one link, and everyone votes on their own phone — so it gets decided by the group, not by whoever answers the chat first.
hero.ctaNote: Nothing to sign up for. The link is the whole thing.

steps.title: Pick a few places
steps.body: Browse what’s open and add anything that could work. Four or five is plenty to vote on.

steps.title: Send one link
steps.body: Everyone opens it, puts in a name, and taps yes, maybe or no. No account, no app — and you can watch the votes land as they come in.

steps.title: Lay out the plan
steps.body: The places the group approved become a schedule. Set how long you want at each one and it retimes itself.

proof.label: How this list is built
proof.sourced: carry a source you can check
proof.editorial: Opening hours come from Google and go stale. Worth a check before you set off.

hero.constellationHint: Hover a dot to name it

home.heading: What’s open in Phnom Penh
home.intro: Sorted by what’s open right now. Add anywhere that could work, then send the list to the group and let them vote on it.
home.empty: No places match these filters yet.

picks.heading: Pick a base, start at the bottom of the list
picks.lead: Each city's least-visited places first. Choose where you're staying and work down toward the famous ones, not up from them.

pairings.heading: Instead of the crowds
pairings.lead: Every hidden place in this guide names the famous one it replaces. Not a list of alternatives — a swap, with the reason attached.

spot.offRadarHint: Higher means fewer visitors and less coverage. Editorial for now — not an algorithm.
spot.sourcesHint: Every claim on this page should be traceable. If something here is wrong, these are the places to check.
spot.sensitiveNote: Not ranked, not paired, and not recommended as an alternative to anything. The off-radar score and the pairing that appear elsewhere on this site are withheld here by design.
spot.unverifiedCaveat: Fees and hours here are unverified and change without notice. Check the sources below before you travel.
spot.hoursUnknownLine: Hours unknown — check before you go
spot.holidayWarning: It's {name}. A lot of places close; check before you go.

map.missingTokenBody: Every place on this site has real coordinates, and nothing here needs a map to work — the route builder included. Open the coordinates in your own maps app instead.
map.selectHint: Select a pin to see the place.

footer.blurb: A going-out planner for friends in Phnom Penh. Pick a few places, send one link, let everyone vote.
footer.editorial: Opening hours and prices here come from Google and from us, not from the venue, and places in Phnom Penh close and move without notice. Nothing on this site is verified on the ground — check the sources on a place's page, or ring ahead, before you set off.

route.emptyTitle: A day with nothing in it yet
route.emptyBody: Nine hours of daylight, starting {start}. Add a place from the list and it lands at the top of the frame below, with travel time to the next one worked out.
route.estimateNote: Arrival times are estimates — straight-line distance, no routing service yet
route.addFirst: Start with the least-visited place in {city}
route.addFirstNote: The default sort, applied to your day
route.suggestionsNote: Least-visited first, and only what fits
route.dayFull: The day is full. {left} left before {end}.
route.dayFullBody: Anything else needs room made for it. Two ways to make some:
route.addOverExplain: Adding this puts you {over} past {end}. Still allowed.
route.reorderNote: Order changes retime the day. Dwell is editable per stop.
route.shortestMovesSensitive: It puts {name} at {time} — worth thinking about.
route.sharedOpen: Open this day and edit it
route.sharedMemorialNote: One stop is a memorial site and is drawn without a score.
route.sharedBadLink: This link doesn't describe a day we can read.
route.noMapNeeded: No map key configured — the route needs none
route.putToVoteHint: Sends everyone a link. They mark yes, maybe or no; it settles itself.
route.voteLinkCopied: Link copied — paste it in the group chat
route.voteNeedsTwo: Add at least two places to vote between.
route.stopsHint: The most-approved this many become the plan. You arrange the times after.
route.shareDescription: Where the group landed, and what time you are at each place.
route.dragHint: Drag a block, or type a time, to fix when a stop starts.

vote.title: Where are we going?
vote.subtitle: {count} places · {when}
vote.nameHint: {count} cards, one tap each — about a minute. Everyone sees who voted; nothing else is kept, and it's all gone tomorrow.

vote.badLink: This link doesn't describe a vote we can read.
vote.shareDescription: Someone put a shortlist up. Tap yes or no on each place — it takes a minute, and there is nothing to sign up for.
vote.pickingOne: Together you're picking one of them.
vote.pickingMany: Together you're picking the {stops} you'll actually go to.
vote.youFirst: Yours is the first vote in.
